pages.text: Every animal keeps a set of $(bold)stats$(): Satiety, Thirst, Cleanliness and Mood, shown on its overhead status panel.
$(bold)Milker$()$(br)Right-click an adult cow to milk it for 2-5 bottles of milk, costing 1 point of the cows Mood each time.
$(bold)Brush$()$(br)Right-click any livestock to slowly raise its Mood and Cleanliness; each animal accepts a brushing only once every 20 seconds.
$(bold)Flea Treatment$()$(br)Right-click an animal to use one: Cleanliness jumps to full and the $(bold)flea bites$() are washed away.
